title: feat(nsyopex): y-symmetric three-site later-tick exist-opposite: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Later-tick exist-opposite on the y-symmetric three-site seed {0,(0,1,0),(0,-1,0)} with locks +e1,-e1,-e1; at T=3 every S_* is a 4-5 letter mixed set, so both bits hold.
